atoms.exact_source_text: How named Citizens, Roles, Places, and whole-colony facts are selected for foreground representation.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how named Citizens, Roles, Places, and whole-colony facts are selected for foreground representation.

atoms.exact_source_text: How unresolved Home situations persist without becoming an entropy treadmill or task inbox.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how unresolved Home situations persist without becoming an entropy treadmill or task inbox.

atoms.exact_source_text: How world facts remain singular while producing different consequences in DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK, MEET, and EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how world facts remain singular while producing different consequences in DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK, MEET, and EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: How personal lives remain descriptive and legible without citizen stat bars, morale meters, or ornamental gauges.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how personal lives remain descriptive and legible without citizen stat bars, morale meters, or ornamental gauges.

atoms.exact_source_text: How environmental pressure is staged over time
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how environmental pressure is staged over time.

atoms.exact_source_text: how visual backdrops preserve spatial continuity
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification governs how visual backdrops preserve spatial continuity.

atoms.exact_source_text: MEDIAN remains continuous and observable until a situation becomes bounded, consequential, and worthy of direct attention.
atoms.normalized_claim: MEDIAN remains continuous and observable until a situation becomes bounded, consequential, and worthy of direct attention.

atoms.exact_source_text: MEET fixes that attention.
atoms.normalized_claim: MEET fixes that attention.

atoms.exact_source_text: The resulting choice acts upon one shared world state, then returns the player to a Register whose ordinary life visibly incorporates what occurred.
atoms.normalized_claim: The resulting choice acts upon one shared world state, then returns the player to a Register whose ordinary life visibly incorporates what occurred.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Register is MEDIAN’s complete visual and interactive contract for one kind of player attention.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Register is MEDIAN’s complete visual and interactive contract for one kind of player attention.

atoms.exact_source_text: It governs framing, scale, time treatment, navigation, available controls, information hierarchy, Citizen representation, and the class of decision being asked for.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Register governs framing, scale, time treatment, navigation, available controls, information hierarchy, Citizen representation, and the class of decision being asked for.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Register is not a geographic zone.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Register is not a geographic zone.

atoms.exact_source_text: DWELL        | Dwell    | Sustain and observe collective life at Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: The DWELL Register, with verb Dwell, has primary attention to sustain and observe collective life at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: TRAVEL       | Travel   | Read territory, route, distance, load, shelter, and changing conditions Away.
atoms.normalized_claim: The TRAVEL Register, with verb Travel, has primary attention to read territory, route, distance, load, shelter, and changing conditions Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: RISK         | Risk     | Act inside immediate embodied danger, especially Crossing.
atoms.normalized_claim: The RISK Register, with verb Risk, has primary attention to act inside immediate embodied danger, especially Crossing.

atoms.exact_source_text: MEET         | Meet     | Attend to a bounded circumstance and decide how the relevant subject responds.
atoms.normalized_claim: The MEET Register, with verb Meet, has primary attention to attend to a bounded circumstance and decide how the relevant subject responds.

atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY       | Embody   | Experience a Citizen’s lived scale within the safety of Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: The EMBODY Register, with verb Embody, has primary attention to experience a Citizen’s lived scale within the safety of Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Register changes because the player’s relationship to a place changes, not because the map location changed.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Register changes because the player’s relationship to a place changes, not because the map location changed.

atoms.exact_source_text: A berry bush is navigable geography in TRAVEL.
atoms.normalized_claim: A berry bush is navigable geography in TRAVEL.

atoms.exact_source_text: It becomes MEET when a party decides what relationship to establish with it or when another Presence contests it.
atoms.normalized_claim: A berry bush becomes MEET when a party decides what relationship to establish with it or when another Presence contests it.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Rabbit court is part of DWELL until Heavy Winds make its exposed shelter line a bounded decision.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Rabbit court is part of DWELL until Heavy Winds make its exposed shelter line a bounded decision.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same court may later become an EMBODY Presence scene once Quiet Equilibrium returns.
atoms.normalized_claim: The same Rabbit court may later become an EMBODY Presence scene once Quiet Equilibrium returns.
